The hiring company is not identified in the posting. The role focuses on developing and maintaining end-to-end web applications, including customer-facing interfaces, backend services, cloud deployments, and automated testing.
Full-stack Web Developer building React interfaces and Node.js REST APIs, and deploying tested applications on GCP

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and maintain end-to-end web applications using React, Node.js, and modern JavaScript frameworks
• Build responsive, accessible, and user-friendly customer-facing interfaces
• Develop scalable RESTful APIs and backend services using Node.js
• Design and integrate data models using PostgreSQL, Cloud SQL, and Firestore
• Implement event-driven architectures using Kafka, webhooks, and third-party integrations
• Deploy and manage applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Cloud Run
• Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment across multiple environments
• Develop automated test suites using Playwright and integration testing frameworks
• Collaborate with product owners, UX designers, architects, and cross-functional teams in Agile/Scrum environments
• Utilize AI-powered development tools to accelerate delivery while performing thorough code reviews, validation, and testing
• Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement preventive solutions
• Participate in peer code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices

Requirements:
• Experience developing end-to-end web applications using React, Node.js, and modern JavaScript frameworks
• Experience building customer-facing, responsive, accessible web applications
• Strong experience developing RESTful APIs and backend services
• Experience with PostgreSQL, Cloud SQL, and Firestore
• Experience implementing event-driven architectures using Kafka, webhooks, and third-party integrations
• Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Cloud Run
• Experience creating and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
• Experience developing automated tests using Playwright and integration testing frameworks
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
• Experience using AI-powered development tools to enhance software delivery
• Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and production support skills
• Experience participating in code reviews and applying engineering best practices
• 0-2 years
• Digital : NOSQL
